Alcohol-related fatty liver disease often begins to improve within **2 to 4 weeks** of stopping alcohol completely, with reversal frequently taking **2 to 8 weeks** depending on how much and how long you drank.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1ycu0gpE0L5SE-pb26Qsb94uS_lg4uCRs5ohnuZV8N60ynFHC6iEpoCSNPfJ7HiqkYqiRXcdHStd41ZcABg1B0dr4TkqxRj0XCKiGRb5d2pQ6JgCwNlZURqjiab6MFY6t7IOAak1v5lbdw6c0WMiqIz6JoI8fwNGAUJuqq4nOnG5_DcWPba7BIeARqX-gnGrvjbpzJw1CRgSWQjrTMDCuOiZ8bCSclmAB3bxe1YeeQan7kT5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgqzyy_Avy_940fWBvulX8F3ZynMjlPyO5IETdeGkm0zxYe0rVAs6RddO5QMOsuIiGSAT9jAfEu68HSfax8ZRgcTKKtl-edwjZguW9FoXNaKhqHlQLEmQJJLPZIaIzzTK5nlawoYqVbDJhQn6QV1oKJqY6A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXAFQrL0-OxkDNfPgtP7zoPw8a-KLRi0iWpNAV-5t5aR-lCwAbvrkZ2CIJyy6qZohh30cSSA4dsFZ_loCOS8csxIsXQlYOXsRrnyAluUVyim2TRxusyUPNCH3PHiD6gGBvLBhhWhxR3-z0Su68f9hC4WEkTqfsPsQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF15hUuIHfG1c7q4VP0dVNCoRA0ODxLph1hZnyG6S-iURnk7DojVsfuIdfJ_48lR0GTD7Dx9wLvWsa0QCzkW_AxbOf7-CR5IGaNuGrvCsSIIcPXMlMSGUpAL3WCkZ466k94rhx1nNAcZfXaj71oeven2AlPJyKnbuRxssPsksdIgw55cRcLtZ3qJyWln43QgRiIsXuPEXgztRX3pMA)

### Typical Recovery Timeline

- **Days to 2 weeks:** The liver begins clearing excess fat and reducing inflammation. Early improvements in sleep, digestion, and energy may start.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXAFQrL0-OxkDNfPgtP7zoPw8a-KLRi0iWpNAV-5t5aR-lCwAbvrkZ2CIJyy6qZohh30cSSA4dsFZ_loCOS8csxIsXQlYOXsRrnyAluUVyim2TRxusyUPNCH3PHiD6gGBvLBhhWhxR3-z0Su68f9hC4WEkTqfsPsQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF171ymv3E8SyN_Iab3o8gISHfYf6BD4pAKktnT-L2378pXr6i9xDbHbNDZArLwTYlvsL5SsJguxFIkEvMdbBWh9XEphNFHysaednc22Nxt1-xSLZJpTPOdEhdDsPlPN8Mr-AeGEBDWbe9yQxDv3LHUETSGQwezqiZiNiy7mVr2-cy3JVDOd4iLFWS)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0AAIWSv1uiU)
- **2 to 4 weeks:** Fat deposits shrink significantly, and many people see measurable drops in liver enzymes (like ALT, AST, and GGT).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF15hUuIHfG1c7q4VP0dVNCoRA0ODxLph1hZnyG6S-iURnk7DojVsfuIdfJ_48lR0GTD7Dx9wLvWsa0QCzkW_AxbOf7-CR5IGaNuGrvCsSIIcPXMlMSGUpAL3WCkZ466k94rhx1nNAcZfXaj71oeven2AlPJyKnbuRxssPsksdIgw55cRcLtZ3qJyWln43QgRiIsXuPEXgztRX3pMA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXAFQrL0-OxkDNfPgtP7zoPw8a-KLRi0iWpNAV-5t5aR-lCwAbvrkZ2CIJyy6qZohh30cSSA4dsFZ_loCOS8csxIsXQlYOXsRrnyAluUVyim2TRxusyUPNCH3PHiD6gGBvLBhhWhxR3-z0Su68f9hC4WEkTqfsPsQ)
- **4 to 8 weeks:** Liver enzymes commonly return to normal ranges in uncomplicated fatty liver, though full healing can take longer if damage has progressed to inflammation (hepatitis) or scarring (fibrosis).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF171ymv3E8SyN_Iab3o8gISHfYf6BD4pAKktnT-L2378pXr6i9xDbHbNDZArLwTYlvsL5SsJguxFIkEvMdbBWh9XEphNFHysaednc22Nxt1-xSLZJpTPOdEhdDsPlPN8Mr-AeGEBDWbe9yQxDv3LHUETSGQwezqiZiNiy7mVr2-cy3JVDOd4iLFWS)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF15hUuIHfG1c7q4VP0dVNCoRA0ODxLph1hZnyG6S-iURnk7DojVsfuIdfJ_48lR0GTD7Dx9wLvWsa0QCzkW_AxbOf7-CR5IGaNuGrvCsSIIcPXMlMSGUpAL3WCkZ466k94rhx1nNAcZfXaj71oeven2AlPJyKnbuRxssPsksdIgw55cRcLtZ3qJyWln43QgRiIsXuPEXgztRX3pMA)

### What Supports Healing

- **Complete abstinence:** Stopping alcohol is the primary step required for the liver to heal. (Check with a doctor before quitting abruptly if you drink heavily, as withdrawal can be dangerous.)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgqzyy_Avy_940fWBvulX8F3ZynMjlPyO5IETdeGkm0zxYe0rVAs6RddO5QMOsuIiGSAT9jAfEu68HSfax8ZRgcTKKtl-edwjZguW9FoXNaKhqHlQLEmQJJLPZIaIzzTK5nlawoYqVbDJhQn6QV1oKJqY6A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF16dDYEz46F5AwUVCCRZ7Z0GYYoeRwkV1ZbeW0y42GnLymi3sl7v6GLGRH9KcFXEHnPSdKybvtYW7-3t5BQ5hV597aFbLUl5ORqQ5Iv0hpmDTyb-qovAcajoKQ5uIFVsW-mdg2vKPwP9aGdDBXzpjBzGLeR1zN9vvcMoRRH6yUGvzfYczltMTIO-R)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF171ymv3E8SyN_Iab3o8gISHfYf6BD4pAKktnT-L2378pXr6i9xDbHbNDZArLwTYlvsL5SsJguxFIkEvMdbBWh9XEphNFHysaednc22Nxt1-xSLZJpTPOdEhdDsPlPN8Mr-AeGEBDWbe9yQxDv3LHUETSGQwezqiZiNiy7mVr2-cy3JVDOd4iLFWS)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF15hUuIHfG1c7q4VP0dVNCoRA0ODxLph1hZnyG6S-iURnk7DojVsfuIdfJ_48lR0GTD7Dx9wLvWsa0QCzkW_AxbOf7-CR5IGaNuGrvCsSIIcPXMlMSGUpAL3WCkZ466k94rhx1nNAcZfXaj71oeven2AlPJyKnbuRxssPsksdIgw55cRcLtZ3qJyWln43QgRiIsXuPEXgztRX3pMA)
- **Balanced nutrition:** Focus on adequate protein, whole foods, fruits, vegetables, and hydration while limiting added sugars, excess salt, and heavy processed fats.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF16dDYEz46F5AwUVCCRZ7Z0GYYoeRwkV1ZbeW0y42GnLymi3sl7v6GLGRH9KcFXEHnPSdKybvtYW7-3t5BQ5hV597aFbLUl5ORqQ5Iv0hpmDTyb-qovAcajoKQ5uIFVsW-mdg2vKPwP9aGdDBXzpjBzGLeR1zN9vvcMoRRH6yUGvzfYczltMTIO-R)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgqzyy_Avy_940fWBvulX8F3ZynMjlPyO5IETdeGkm0zxYe0rVAs6RddO5QMOsuIiGSAT9jAfEu68HSfax8ZRgcTKKtl-edwjZguW9FoXNaKhqHlQLEmQJJLPZIaIzzTK5nlawoYqVbDJhQn6QV1oKJqY6A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXAFQrL0-OxkDNfPgtP7zoPw8a-KLRi0iWpNAV-5t5aR-lCwAbvrkZ2CIJyy6qZohh30cSSA4dsFZ_loCOS8csxIsXQlYOXsRrnyAluUVyim2TRxusyUPNCH3PHiD6gGBvLBhhWhxR3-z0Su68f9hC4WEkTqfsPsQ)
- **Regular movement:** Consistent physical activity supports metabolic health and liver recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXMKsiXxJjm9riVI7kig2Vex6YajBariwYQjiitBZMHwTlGjscG5ptXkXjJgItNjC7dAMz8cNIzpWsaEVjV2wximtXumrpMmCWNEz0dOuKl6W6W3sX2lGNvcw0ZG8cmyNRQ2c7joXTMP5VNWVTBo8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF16dDYEz46F5AwUVCCRZ7Z0GYYoeRwkV1ZbeW0y42GnLymi3sl7v6GLGRH9KcFXEHnPSdKybvtYW7-3t5BQ5hV597aFbLUl5ORqQ5Iv0hpmDTyb-qovAcajoKQ5uIFVsW-mdg2vKPwP9aGdDBXzpjBzGLeR1zN9vvcMoRRH6yUGvzfYczltMTIO-R)

You can read more about stage-by-stage recovery in the [NHS inform guide on alcohol-related liver disease](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1ycu0gpE0L5SE-pb26Qsb94uS_lg4uCRs5ohnuZV8N60ynFHC6iEpoCSNPfJ7HiqkYqiRXcdHStd41ZcABg1B0dr4TkqxRj0XCKiGRb5d2pQ6JgCwNlZURqjiab6MFY6t7IOAak1v5lbdw6c0WMiqIz6JoI8fwNGAUJuqq4nOnG5_DcWPba7BIeARqX-gnGrvjbpzJw1CRgSWQjrTMDCuOiZ8bCSclmAB3bxe1YeeQan7kT5), [Cleveland Clinic's overview of liver detox](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgqzyy_Avy_940fWBvulX8F3ZynMjlPyO5IETdeGkm0zxYe0rVAs6RddO5QMOsuIiGSAT9jAfEu68HSfax8ZRgcTKKtl-edwjZguW9FoXNaKhqHlQLEmQJJLPZIaIzzTK5nlawoYqVbDJhQn6QV1oKJqY6A) , or a scientific review on [natural recovery by the liver after chronic alcohol use](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX74FAXO7lsaqYjcUxPyji2paF53EzGe8pjen4cpVoIrFLXG8D1NhbqDu75a6cVyrTSSqA-SHJSP4W3Bqp4TroZeTN46nus_n8wzkrhp7Je6cc7G4qdbhs8bk7WzIQY1EHmbJXua81gVnp).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESuAEBxCJF1ycu0gpE0L5SE-pb26Qsb94uS_lg4uCRs5ohnuZV8N60ynFHC6iEpoCSNPfJ7HiqkYqiRXcdHStd41ZcABg1B0dr4TkqxRj0XCKiGRb5d2pQ6JgCwNlZURqjiab6MFY6t7IOAak1v5lbdw6c0WMiqIz6JoI8fwNGAUJuqq4nOnG5_DcWPba7BIeARqX-gnGrvjbpzJw1CRgSWQjrTMDCuOiZ8bCSclmAB3bxe1YeeQan7kT5)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXgqzyy_Avy_940fWBvulX8F3ZynMjlPyO5IETdeGkm0zxYe0rVAs6RddO5QMOsuIiGSAT9jAfEu68HSfax8ZRgcTKKtl-edwjZguW9FoXNaKhqHlQLEmQJJLPZIaIzzTK5nlawoYqVbDJhQn6QV1oKJqY6A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXX74FAXO7lsaqYjcUxPyji2paF53EzGe8pjen4cpVoIrFLXG8D1NhbqDu75a6cVyrTSSqA-SHJSP4W3Bqp4TroZeTN46nus_n8wzkrhp7Je6cc7G4qdbhs8bk7WzIQY1EHmbJXua81gVnp)Are you looking into this for yourself or someone else?
